title: last_element wrong index
description: last_element should return the final item of a list, but it returns the second-to-last due to an off-by-one index.

hidden_tests.test_listutil.py:
from listutil import last_element


def test_last():
    assert last_element([1, 2, 3]) == 3
    assert last_element(['a', 'b']) == 'b'
    assert last_element([42]) == 42
